# Qorvena

> Qorvena is an appointment management web app. People create an account, save their appointments with a date and time, get an email confirmation when an appointment is booked, and receive an email reminder before it starts.

Qorvena works in any modern browser on phones, tablets and computers, in light or dark mode. Each account has its own private list of appointments.

## What Qorvena does
- Save an appointment with a title, date, time and optional notes.
- Send an email confirmation as soon as an appointment is booked.
- Send an email reminder before the appointment starts; the person chooses how long before.
- Include a calendar file with appointment emails.
- Let people reset a forgotten password with a code sent by email.

## How it works
1. Create an account with an email address and password.
2. Add an appointment: pick the date and time and choose when to be reminded.
3. Receive a confirmation email now and a reminder email just before it starts.

## About the name
QORVENA is an original coined name inspired by the Latin word "Vena", meaning "vein". It symbolizes the continuous flow of information and coordination within the system: like veins connecting parts of the body, Qorvena connects appointment requests, scheduling processes and automated notifications in one centralized platform.
